CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "barcode" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isSellable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isVisibleOnline" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "nameFr" text,
  "origin" text,
  "packaging" text,
  "productType" text NOT NULL,
  "salePrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "scientificName" text,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
